name: KAST Dollar
oneLiner: USDK is KAST's 1:1 extension of M0's M token on Solana; it inherits M's upstream collateral and governance while KAST retains the underlying yield.
collateral: M0 M held through the USDK extension relationship. USDK-specific sources do not publish the current upstream M issuer allocation, collateral composition, or custody split; those risks are inherited from M. KAST retains the underlying yield rather than passing it to USDK holders.
pegMechanism: 1:1 wrapper around M (M0) on Solana: KAST mints USDK by depositing/wrapping M into the USDK SPL Token-2022 mint, and unwraps back to M for redemption; user-facing fiat on/off-ramp and redemption are mediated by the KAST app via licensed partners (Tazapay, BitGo, Fireblocks). The Token-2022 mint has transfer hooks and confidential-transfer extensions with authority held by KAST

State decoded as NoYield and the USDK multiplier was 1. Extension extaykYu5AQcDm3qZAbiDN3yp6skqn6Nssj7veUUGZw remains upgradeable; executable SHA-256 is 1cb25a14dc8ad22bccbf9012de130044e6404eb4260780b98151bcd8517b55a6. https://verify.osec.io/status/extaykYu5AQcDm3qZAbiDN3yp6skqn6Nssj7veUUGZw reports 'On chain program not verified'. No pure-wrapper classification is applied until a matching reproducible build proves the complete fixed-unit M claim. RPC read: https://solana-mainnet.g.alchemy.com . Published-source intent, not deployed equivalence: https://github.com/m0-foundation/solana-m-extensions/tree/b69d1f8d8be34f34aaac4d1060cec37f81dba0af/programs/m_ext/src/instructions (wrap.rs transfers M before minting; unwrap.rs burns before releasing M, both permissioned).
